baseGeneration.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Generate a BRAND-NEW finished illustration from the ORIGINAL CHARACTER REFERENCES, drawn from scratch in a single pass. This is not an edit, restoration, upscale or repaint of a previous tea-party image. No previous generated group illustration is provided. Use the references only to establish character designs, faces, clothing and rendering quality.

Output: one highly detailed, clean, sharp 1536x1024 landscape anime fantasy RPG story still, 3:2 composition. Fine precise linework, luminous softly shaded anime faces, individually defined hair strands, clear cloth folds and fine gold embroidery. Refined restrained colors, clear local detail and coherent anatomy; soft lighting without blurred or muddy characters. Normal character proportions, NOT chibi, no photorealism, no heavy impasto, no over-sharpening halos.

Reference mapping:
1: Finn's original user-supplied character concept. His TOP-RIGHT portrait holding a mug is the required laughing expression.
2: Mira's original costume and hairstyle reference sheet. She is an ADULT woman in her mid-twenties; ignore any text/age labels on the sheet.
3: Mira's user-supplied face icon atlas, authoritative for her distinctly pale complexion, heavy eyelids and soft gray-lavender under-eye tiredness.
4: Aria's character reference sheet.
5: Leon's character reference sheet.
Ignore all sheet layouts and lettering. Produce a single scene, not a collage.

Scene: the four companions share tea at a humble timber-and-plaster dining room in the stone town of Berne, at dusk after restoring its beacon tower. This is a candid moment in conversation: Leon asks Finn about a lingering debt, Finn laughs it off, Aria joins in, Mira quietly pours tea. The mood is warm and familiar with Finn's irresponsible charm, not a formal posed group portrait.

Composition: exactly FOUR distinct people in a readable gently curved arrangement around a wooden table. From viewer-left to right: Aria, Leon, Finn, Mira. All faces are prominently visible, medium upper-body framing, no obscured faces, no heads cut off; the four occupy most of the frame rather than a small portion of a vast room. Aria and Leon sit close naturally without overt romance. Leon turns toward Finn; Finn's head is gently angled toward Leon while laughing; Mira looks toward the cup she is filling. Hands and the central tableware remain clearly visible. Some modest bread and shared supper dishes in the foreground, leaving visual room for the hand actions.

Finn: handsome visibly middle-aged man in his late forties, lightly tanned skin, stubble, subtle crow's feet, loosely tied low dark-brown wavy hair, loose strands across his face, small earrings. Worn dark olive-charcoal cloak with subdued antique-gold embroidery, open-neck ivory shirt and humble necklace as reference 1. ESSENTIAL EXPRESSION: BOTH EYES COMPLETELY CLOSED in natural smiling arcs, no pupils, and mouth naturally OPEN in a relaxed cheerful laugh, matching the TOP-RIGHT mug-holding portrait of reference 1. Soft raised cheeks, believable mouth and smile lines, effortless slightly roguish warmth, no frozen crooked grimace or manic laughter. Holds one plain ceramic tea cup with BOTH hands. ESSENTIAL ACCESSORIES: thin clean bandage around his RIGHT wrist and back of RIGHT hand (on the VIEWER'S LEFT side of his cup), fingers free. His LEFT hand (on the VIEWER'S RIGHT side of his cup) is bare and has TWO clearly visible simple worn rings: dull brass index-finger band and tarnished silver ring-finger band. Correct finger anatomy and rings seated at finger bases, modest inexpensive jewelry, no large gems. Not a young clean-shaven prince and not an exaggerated elderly caricature.

Mira: adult woman with long soft pale-lavender partially braided hair, violet eyes, crescent moon and white-flower hair ornament, white and muted lavender off-shoulder healer robes with delicate gold trim, medicine pouches. Follow reference 2 costume exactly. ESSENTIAL COMPLEXION: distinctly pale cool ivory skin, low rosy saturation on cheeks/nose/lips, heavy upper eyelids with gentle gray-violet under-eye shadows matching reference 3. Visible quiet fatigue even with her small kind smile. Face, neck and bare shoulders have consistent pale coloring. Not healthy rosy cheeks, not a cosmetic glamour blush, not bruised/green/ashen or elderly. She pours tea from a ceramic pot into a cup standing on the table. Her pouring hand securely grips the teapot HANDLE, with anatomically correct fingers; keep a natural small stream entering the cup.

Aria: recognizable youthful female elf, long ash-beige blonde braided half-up hair, long pointed ears, green eyes, white flowers and feather hair ornament, sage/forest-green gold-embroidered cloak with hood DOWN, ivory blouse, brown leather bodice and gloves. Lively amused expression, slightly leaning toward the conversation. Match reference 4.
Leon: recognizable youthful human man, short layered neutral brown hair, warm brown eyes, muted brick-red scarf, slate-blue gold-trimmed tunic, steel shoulder armor, brown gloves, leather straps. Kind but gently skeptical expression as he speaks to Finn, one hand rests by his own cup. Match reference 5.

Props and backdrop: exactly FOUR tea cups total, ONE held by Finn and THREE resting on the table, one of those being filled by Mira. A modest ceramic teapot, shared food and a small warm lamp. Through a window behind the group, stone rooftops and ONE modest local stone beacon tower with a soft pale-violet glow from its windows. Early evening violet sky, subdued interior warmth, no overwhelming orange or sepia filter. Tower is a background detail, not a giant castle or a beam of magical energy.

Priority: crisp original-reference-quality faces and hands; Finn's closed-eye open-mouth laugh; his two rings and correct RIGHT-hand bandage; Mira's pale tired face; all four recognizable costumes. No extra characters or limbs, no text, watermarks, panels, speech bubbles, emoticons, heart symbols, overt romance or victory poses.
